result.reason: The clause uses the permitted fallback limits for E&O (USD 1M) and cyber (USD 2M), includes the required CGL limits, and requires certificates on request. However, it omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law, so it does not fully reach the fallback position. Requiring all coverage for one year after the term is not required by the playbook and is an unnecessary expansion. The unrelated notices provision is substantively preserved.
